# Contributing to Reikai JP

Reikai JP is a personal project: one owner, with development done mostly by AI coding agents and
kept up by automated checks. So this repository takes no issues and reviews no pull requests.

- **A problem that also happens in upstream Reikai** (the library, sources, trackers, the manga
  reader): report it to [Reikai](https://github.com/unseensnick/Reikai/issues), where it can be
  fixed for everyone. Reikai JP picks up Reikai's fixes every week.
- **A problem with a source or extension**: that belongs to whoever maintains it; Reikai JP ships
  no sources.
- **Code**: you are welcome to fork. Everything the fork adds is laid out in
  [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [docs/fork/](../docs/fork/): what it is, how it is built
  ([architecture](../docs/fork/architecture.md)), and why it is the way it is
  ([decisions](../docs/fork/decisions.md)). The code is GPL-3.0-or-later.
